name: s1_money
text: God doesn't want you rich. There, I said it. And a lot of preachers want your money more than God does. But watch what Jesus actually taught you to ask for. One day's bread. In the wilderness, Israel tried saving extra manna for tomorrow, and by morning it had worms in it. God wasn't being cheap. He was teaching them to look up every morning. Matthew six, verse eleven. Give us this day our daily bread. Today's bread, from Him. The full morning prayer is on the channel.

name: s2_heaven
text: Most Christians don't actually want heaven. They want the mansion. They want grandma back. They want no more bills. So here's a test. If heaven had all of that, but God wasn't there, would you still go? Be straight with yourself. David answered it a long time ago. Psalm seventy-three, verse twenty-five. Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee. If your answer scared you, tell Him tonight. He can change what your heart wants.

name: s3_sleep
text: Praying before bed won't fix your problems. You're right. The bill is still due in the morning. Prayer was never meant to make it disappear. It hands the night shift to somebody who doesn't need sleep. You've been standing guard all night like it's your job. It isn't. Psalm one twenty-one, verse four. Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep. Hand Him the watch, and go to sleep.

name: s4_fire
text: Stop asking God to take your problems away. He never promised you a life with no fire. Ask the three Hebrew boys. They wouldn't bow, so the king threw them in a furnace so hot it killed the men who threw them in. God didn't put the fire out. He got in it with them. Daniel three, verse twenty-five. He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God. The king looked in and counted four. Whatever you're walking through tonight, you're not in there by yourself.

name: s5_anxiety
text: Just pray about it is the worst thing you can tell an anxious person. Most people say it to end the conversation. Paul didn't say just pray. He said bring every single thing, with thanks, and God puts a guard on your heart. Philippians four, verses six and seven. Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus. Keep means guard. Let Him stand watch tonight.
